details.description: Yi-34B-Chat is a 34-billion-parameter bilingual (English/Chinese) chat model from 01.AI, instruction-tuned from the Yi-34B base model and released in November 2023. It was trained on roughly 3 trillion multilingual tokens for general language understanding, commonsense reasoning and reading comprehension, with a default 4,096-token context window (01.AI separately offers a longer-context Yi-34B-Chat-200K variant). 01.AI has since released the upgraded Yi-1.5 series (May 2024), which the company says further improves coding, math, reasoning and instruction-following over the original Yi series.
advantages: Placed second, behind GPT-4 Turbo, on the AlpacaEval Leaderboard at the time of its evaluation.
Ranked first among open-source models on the CMMLU benchmark, per 01.AI.
Released under the Apache 2.0 license, free for personal, academic and commercial use.
01.AI says the model produces more diverse responses, which suits creative-writing use cases.
disadvantages: Superseded by 01.AI's own Yi-1.5 series (May 2024), which the company says further improves coding, math, reasoning and instruction-following.
01.AI cautions that the model's response diversity can amplify hallucination risk and cause non-determinism across regenerations.
use_cases: General-purpose bilingual (English/Chinese) chat and instruction following.
Creative writing, given the model's more diverse response style.

notes: Catalog facts give a flat 4,096-token max_input and max_output, matching the model's default context window; 01.AI's README also documents a separate Yi-34B-Chat-200K model id with a longer context, which is a different catalog entry and not claimed here. Evaluations left empty because the only additional quantitative score found (MMLU '~80%') was approximate rather than an exact published figure.
